note: Per-strategy Phase-B scope of record. Each strategy -> one frontier-v3 extraction. element_inventory = variants + coverage-flagged items the extractor must ACCOUNT FOR (appear or absent-with-reason).

strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_break_entry
strategies.entry_summary: At 9:30 ET mark high/low of first candle; wait for price to break that level leaving a fair value gap (3-candle imbalance); break direction sets bias; enter on the FVG when price trades back into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop just beyond the FVG on the invalidation side (1 tick room); take profit at fixed R-multiple (3:1 or 2:1 per variant); let it run to target/stop.
element_inventory: scalping variant: 5m levels/1m entry, retest+engulfing confirmation, 3:1
day-trading variant: 15m levels/5m entry, passive limit order, 2:1

strategies.name: vwap_band_trend_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: With a directional bias, wait for price to run to the 1st/2nd VWAP std-dev band, then after it breaks/retests enter WITH the move (e.g. long once price pushed to band and held).
strategies.exit_summary: Use 2nd and 3rd std-dev bands as profit target; exit only via band targets (no explicit stop).

strategies.name: vwap_band_mean_reversion
strategies.entry_summary: Treat outer std-dev bands as overbought/oversold; when price reaches an outer band (e.g. runs into lower deviations) enter a reversal against the extreme back toward fair value.
strategies.exit_summary: Target the central VWAP as the price-rebalancing target; exit is VWAP mean (no explicit stop).

strategies.name: support_bounce_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: Let first 5-15 min establish support; enter long when price wicks down to dynamic support (13 EMA, or 200 EMA once 13 EMA loses support status, or demand zone) and bounces.
strategies.exit_summary: Ride bounce to resistance, take profit quickly (few green candles / 10-50c); get in and out, don't overstay; scalp then repeat.
element_inventory: COVERAGE: breakdown 'big move once support lost' = unpromoted mention, absent-with-reason (no runnable entry)

strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Find a liquidity grab (price breaks S/R, fakes out, reverses; buy-side or sell-side); enter at the candle that made the grab: long on support/buy-side grab, short on resistance/sell-side grab; any instrument/timeframe.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop just below the grab for longs (above for shorts); take profit at a recent swing high (low for shorts); large R:R.

strategies.name: premarket_range_break_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: On 5m, mark pre-market high/low (3:00 ET London open to 9:30 ET NY open); on clean break above high or below low enter in break direction at breakout candle close OR on a retest of the level.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop opposite side of entry candle; target >=1x risk, ideally 1.5-2x; trail to breakeven then into profit, scale out, let runner go.
element_inventory: break-and-retest entry variant (pullback to level as S/R, multiple retests = multiple entries)

strategies.name: premarket_range_liquidity_sweep_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: At same pre-market high/low, watch for liquidity sweep: brief fakeout past the level that fails and reclaims; enter OPPOSITE the failed break on reclaim (sweep below low -> long).
strategies.exit_summary: Stop opposite side of entry candle; target >=1x, ideally 1.5-2x; trail to breakeven then profit, scale out, let run.

strategies.name: fvg_trend_continuation_entry
strategies.entry_summary: In a trending market find a valid FVG (imbalance: gap from 1st candle close to 3rd candle open across 3 candles) that caused a break of structure and sits close to the order block, after liquidity cleared; wait for price to retrace/tap the FVG, enter WITH the trend (buy bullish FVG in uptrend, sell bearish FVG in downtrend).
strategies.exit_summary: Stop just below FVG for buys (above for sells), kept tight to the FVG not dragged to the order block; target gestural (hold as price pushes), no explicit R.
element_inventory: COVERAGE: order block (prior video), breaker blocks (next video), flip zone = named/deferred models, absent-with-reason (no runnable entry taught here)

strategies.name: ict_aplus_entry_checklist
strategies.entry_summary: After stop raid (liquidity swept beyond prior low/high) + market structure shift/displacement, wait for price to return into discount (below 0.5, into OTE) then enter at a PD array in that zone (FVG, order block, breaker block, OTE, or box setup), blending 1-3 for confluence.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop beyond the PD array/entry swing; take first partial, optionally stop to break-even; target opposing buy/sell-side liquidity (session/morning highs), let runners run.

strategies.name: mean_reversion_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On sharp fast move into support (mirror resistance) backed by large bids/offers, read tape for volume stalling (sellers stop hitting bid = momentum turn); take the offer and get long in front of support.
strategies.exit_summary: GESTURAL: capture the bounce off the level; bids at support = protection. No explicit target.

strategies.name: continuation_breakout_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On break of clean level be first in on the break (buy $10.01/$10.02 above $10 resistance, or $50.01 as large offer shrinks then disappears); confirm via order flow (aggressive lifting, prints, shrinking offer).
strategies.exit_summary: Scalp into emotional follow-through, kick out 10/20/30c higher; stop just below the broken level.
element_inventory: COVERAGE: opening $25-offer example = same continuation skeleton, folds in

strategies.name: spread_making_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: In liquid but thin name near equilibrium, provide liquidity: place resting limit orders ahead of large bids/offers, market-maker style, to capture the spread as urgent participants cross.
strategies.exit_summary: GESTURAL: capture the spread difference; Facebook-IPO example slam bids then kick offers out a point higher, repeat. No explicit stop.
element_inventory: COVERAGE: swing trading = risk-contrast mention, absent-with-reason

strategies.name: htf_irl_fvg_1m_inversion
strategies.entry_summary: 9:30-11:30 NY: mark draw on liquidity (Asia/London/prev-day high/low, equal highs/lows). After 9:30 wait for 5m (or 15m) FVG toward the draw; on tap drop to 1m, require prior liquidity sweep, enter on 1m inversion (price closes through FVG into IFVG with displacement); if multiple 1m FVGs, wait for all to invert.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop beyond sweep high/low; target draw on liquidity OR fixed 1:2 (speaker prefers 1:2); move to break-even once closest liquidity past entry taken.
element_inventory: COVERAGE: long/short = direction mirror, one object

strategies.name: vwap_20sma_confluence_long
strategies.entry_summary: On 2m, first candle off bell closes above BOTH 20 SMA and VWAP; wait for following candle to confirm that candle's high; enter long at confluence; buy bounces that wick into but don't close below VWAP; optionally add/DCA on pullbacks.
strategies.exit_summary: TWO MANDATORY exit units: (a) SCALP - sell into upper VWAP band ~15-20pt; (b) HOLD/TRAIL - once price breaks away from VWAP trail the 20 SMA, exit on close below it ~75pt. Stops under prior wick/low.

strategies.name: vwap_20sma_rejection_short
strategies.entry_summary: RULE-2 OPPOSITION (do NOT merge with long): when price loses both VWAP and 20 SMA collectively, closes below VWAP, and following candle builds below, stop buying bounces and short the rejection of VWAP and the 20 SMA.
strategies.exit_summary: GESTURAL: taught as inverse trigger, no explicit target/stop; null level fields, keep words verbatim, flag gestural. NEVER delete.
element_inventory: MANDATORY: this whole short object (recovered from v3.0 merge-silencing, cross-path confirmed)

strategies.name: abc_trend_continuation_reclaim
strategies.entry_summary: With 4h/1h bullish, drop to 15m/5m and track corrective lower-highs/lower-lows; enter long once price stops making lower lows (higher low) AND breaks back above the last lower high (ABC reclaim).
strategies.exit_summary: Stop under the swing low; target 1h high, scale with trend (~1:10 up to ~1:32 if 4h breaks); gestural 'scalp out' for the scalp variant.
element_inventory: COVERAGE: bearish tracking = diagnostic only, no short taught

strategies.name: overnight_range_break_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Mark overnight/pre-market range (4pm-9:30am ET) high/low; wait for a candle-close break beyond the range (strength above / weakness below) aligned with overall trend; enter on the pullback that retests the broken level with a confirming candle (engulfing/hammer/doji/long wick) + volume.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop opposite side of breakout point; trim first target, move stop to break-even, let winner run until satisfied/stopped in profit (~1.5-2.6R examples).
element_inventory: COVERAGE: breakout-without-retest entry = mention/dismissed-variant (speaker prefers retest); account for in coverage_notes or as dispreferred variant

strategies.name: orb_15m_immediate_breakout
strategies.entry_summary: On 15m (NY), mark high/low of 9:30 open candle = opening range; wait for a candle to break AND close outside the range; enter at open of next candle; no entries after 12:00; skip ranges too small/large vs ATR.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop at opposite end of opening range (bottom for long); target 1.5:1.
element_inventory: COVERAGE: 'enter as soon as price breaks' = rejected alternative, absent-with-reason

strategies.name: orb_breakout_pullback_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: On 5m, opening range = first three candles; require breakout height > ~1x ATR; do NOT enter immediately - wait for pullback into range, a candle that dips in but closes back above, then enter on break of that candle's high.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop at bottom of opening range (alt: pullback-candle low); target 1.5:1, also swept 2.5-4.5.
element_inventory: stop-order at ORB top (no confirmation) variant
COVERAGE: closing 'do the opposite / breakout momentum' idea = future-backtest mention, absent-with-reason

strategies.name: break_and_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a key level (pre-market high/low, prev-day high/low, or 30-min ORB high/low); wait for strong volume-confirmed break, then pullback and retest that holds (broken resistance->support / support->resistance); enter on confirmation price action (bullish/bearish wicks/hammers/dojis), optional MA reclaim (80MA/8EMA) + Bookmap.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop just beyond opposite side of breakout level; target next obvious liquidity (prev high/low, supply/demand zone); fixed risk, A+ only, 1-2 trades/day.

strategies.name: three_step_engulfing_orb_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: (1) Bias from bullish/bearish engulfing on the 7am & 8am 1H candles; (2) mark 9:30-9:45 opening range on 5m, require break-and-close outside in bias direction; (3) enter on retrace to demand/supply POI (or range edge) via engulfing confirmation or passive limit; session 9:30-11:00 ET.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop beyond range/entry level; take profit at opposing supply/demand level ('looking left') ~2-2.3R; optionally break-even once in profit or exit manually.

strategies.name: vwap_reclaim_pullback_dip_buy
strategies.entry_summary: In momentum penny stocks (avg vol >200k/min over trailing 20min; float <50M ideally <10M) that opened weak below VWAP then broke back above VWAP on volume with consecutive green candles: buy the pullback that retests VWAP (or whole-dollar level) as support, anticipating a bounce. Do NOT enter if VWAP is above price.
strategies.exit_summary: GESTURAL (v3.1 boundary fixture): 'scalp out of it' / 'ride the bounce up' / take profit into strength; no explicit stop/target. Null level fields, preserve exit words verbatim, flag gestural. NEVER delete.
element_inventory: COVERAGE: three examples (XCLB/XELB, SOS, CEMI) = same skeleton different tickers, not variants
COVERAGE: 'VWAP as resistance, never buy if VWAP above' = no-trade filter not opposition
COVERAGE: buying high-of-day breaks = others' mistake, unpromoted mention
